title: [C13T4] - University Sports Centre Redevelopment
prompt: The plans below show the layout of a university's sports center now, and how it will look after redevelopment. Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The plans illustrate the current layout of a university sports centre and the proposed redevelopment that will transform the facility.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the sports centre is set to undergo significant expansion, with numerous new facilities being added while some existing structures will be removed. Most notably, the outdoor courts will be replaced by indoor amenities, and the centre will offer a wider range of recreational and commercial services.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding existing facilities, the 25-metre pool will remain centrally located, directly north of the reception area, although surrounded by new structures. The gym, currently positioned along the northern edge, will be substantially expanded eastward, nearly doubling in size. The reception will continue serving as the main entrance, with changing room and seating maintaining their positions flanking the pool. However, both outdoor courts on the eastern and western sides will be completely demolished to accommodate new developments.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In terms of additions, a leisure pool will be constructed on the western side, replacing the outdoor courts. On the eastern side, a sports hall will occupy the former court area, with two dance studios built adjacent to it. The changing facilities will be expanded significantly, with two additional changing rooms added in the southeastern and southwestern corners of the complex. Furthermore, commercial amenities will be introduced, including a café positioned between the reception and eastern facilities, and a sports shop located in the southwestern corner beside the western changing room.
